description: Buddy Phase 8 — Advanced Intelligence & Self-Tuning. Phase 7 hardened execution. Phase 8 makes the bot SMARTER: regime-aware ATR tuning, cross-session learning, automated model promotion, spread-aware timing, and cross-pair signal aggregation. userStories.title: Regime transition tracker with Markov chain probabilities
userStories.description: Track volatility regime transitions as a Markov chain to predict likely next regime. Uses observed transition frequencies (LOW→NORMAL→HIGH→EXTREME) to compute forward-looking regime probabilities for proactive risk adjustment.
acceptanceCriteria: New class RegimeTransitionTracker in src/scanner/automation/regime_tracker.py
Maintains transition count matrix (4x4) persisted to trained_data/regime_transitions.json
update(current_regime) called each scan cycle, updates transition counts
predict_next() returns probability distribution over 4 regimes based on current state
get_regime_risk_modifier() returns position size modifier: 1.0 normal, 0.85 if P(EXTREME|current) > 0.3
Wired into engine.py scan loop — updates per cycle, modifier passed to execution
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: RegimeTransitionTracker with 4x4 Markov matrix, persists every 5 updates via safe_json, wired into engine.py scan loop with Counter.most_common for dominant regime. Risk modifier 0.85 when P(EXTREME) >= 0.30.

userStories.title: Adaptive ATR multipliers by regime state
userStories.description: Dynamically adjust SL/TP ATR multipliers based on detected volatility regime. LOW regime uses tighter stops, HIGH/EXTREME regime widens TP to capture larger moves. Replaces static multipliers with regime-lookup table.
acceptanceCriteria: ScannerConfig gets regime_atr_multipliers: dict mapping regime → {sl_mult, tp_mult}
Default: LOW(0.8, 1.2), NORMAL(1.0, 1.5), HIGH(1.1, 2.0), EXTREME(1.2, 2.8)
engine.py passes regime-specific multipliers to execution instead of static config values
execution.py _calculate_base_tp_pips and SL calc use regime multipliers when available
Trade journal logs which regime multiplier was applied per trade
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: regime_atr_multipliers dict added to ScannerConfig with 4 regime defaults. engine.py _scan_pair applies regime-specific sl_mult/tp_mult before per-pair overrides. Journal logs regime_atr_multipliers in regime section.

userStories.title: Cross-session learning persistence with session snapshots
userStories.description: Write a session summary snapshot on scan completion: agent weights, accuracy per pair, regime distribution, win rate. Enable ConfigTuner to compare across sessions and recommend parameter adjustments.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionSnapshot dataclass with: timestamp, agent_weights, pair_accuracies, regime_counts, trade_count, win_rate, avg_rr
save_session_snapshot() writes to trained_data/session_snapshots/{timestamp}.json
load_recent_snapshots(n=5) loads last N snapshots for comparison
Cross-session weight blending: new_weight = 0.7 * current + 0.3 * avg(last 5 sessions)
Wired into continuous.py — snapshot saved when watch loop exits cleanly
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: SessionSnapshotManager with save/load/blend. EMA blending (0.7 current + 0.3 historical avg). Wired into continuous.py watch loop exit with agent weights and pair accuracies from agent_weight_path.

userStories.title: Automated A/B model promotion with statistical significance
userStories.description: Formalize shadow test promotion with Fisher exact test. Auto-promote candidate model when it outperforms incumbent by >5% accuracy with p < 0.05 over 50+ shadow predictions.
acceptanceCriteria: New method ModelManager.check_promotion_readiness() returns PromotionResult dataclass
PromotionResult: incumbent_acc, candidate_acc, p_value, sample_size, should_promote, reason
Fisher exact test (scipy.stats) or fallback chi-squared for significance
Promotion criteria: delta > 0.05 AND p < 0.05 AND sample_size >= 50
Auto-promotion: rename candidate → incumbent, log to trained_data/model_version_history.jsonl
Rollback guard: if promoted model drops >5% accuracy in next 20 trades, auto-revert
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: check_promotion_with_significance() with Fisher exact test (scipy), chi-squared fallback, and normal approximation last resort. auto_promote_if_ready() logs to version_history.jsonl with timestamps.

userStories.title: Spread-aware execution timing gate
userStories.description: Check current bid-ask spread before order placement. If spread exceeds pair-specific threshold, delay or skip execution. Reduces slippage from wide-spread entries during low-liquidity periods.
acceptanceCriteria: New method _check_spread_conditions() in ExecutionManager
Fetches current bid/ask from OANDA pricing API (with retry)
Spread threshold: configurable max_spread_pips per pair (default 3.0 from config)
If spread > threshold: return ExecutionResult(success=False, error='spread too wide')
Log spread at entry to journal: spread_pips field in entry_record
Wired into execute_trade() BEFORE order placement, AFTER all other gates
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: _check_spread_conditions() fetches OANDA pricing, computes spread in pips, blocks if > max_spread_pips. Wired before SL/TP price calc. spread_pips injected into ctx and logged in journal entry_record.

userStories.title: Cross-pair signal aggregation with group momentum
userStories.description: Aggregate directional signals across correlated currency groups (USD, JPY, EUR, etc.) to compute group momentum. Block trades when individual signal conflicts with group direction. Boost position when aligned.
acceptanceCriteria: New class GroupMomentumAggregator in src/scanner/automation/group_momentum.py
Maps each pair to currency groups (e.g., EUR_USD → EUR group + USD group)
compute_group_momentum(scan_results) returns per-group directional score (-1 to +1)
Trade filter: skip if pair confidence > 0.55 but group momentum < -0.2 (conflicting)
Trade boost: if group momentum > 0.5 aligned with direction, +5% position size
Group momentum logged per trade in journal and observations.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: GroupMomentumAggregator with 27 pair→currency mappings. compute_group_momentum averages confidence-weighted direction signals per currency. evaluate_trade returns block/boost/allow with alignment score. Wired into engine.py execute_trades as pre-filter. group_momentum dict logged in journal entry_record. Functional test: EUR bullish pattern correctly boosts LONG and blocks SHORT.
